channel.title: GitTube weekly digest

item.title: GitTube weekly digest: week 45, 2026 (2–8 Nov 2026)
item.description:
The best of GitHub this week (2–8 Nov 2026), picked from GitTube's lanes. This entry is refreshed daily until the week ends.

Star-growth numbers appear once GitTube has a few days of history.

Today

  • SoapmakerDepot/hwid-spoofer ★ 300: Complete standalone setup for Hwid Spoofer Free, ready-to-run desktop installation with all features active.
  • MomentumGuideContact/fonetrans ★ 299: Complete Fonetrans desktop edition 2026, ready-to-run with all features fully activated.
  • Balanov/skein (Go) ★ 259: Fail-closed swarm orchestration with epoch-fenced work and late-completion rejection.

This week

  • deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype (TypeScript) ★ 16,507: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System
  • storytold/craft-anything (Rust) ★ 7,911: Craft Anything: understand how any software works, and craft your own.
  • heydamir/unslop (JavaScript) ★ 7,401: A Claude skill that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface

Python

  • Gathin23/cleanyourtv (Python) ★ 51,254: Debloat any Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi and get an Apple TV-style home.
  • deepseek-ai/DeepInfer (Python) ★ 25,194: DeepInfer: High-performance, large-scale inference framework for DeepSeek models
  • google-research/harness2 (Python) ★ 22,402

Rust

  • storytold/wordcraft (Rust) ★ 17,184: An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft Word in pure Rust
  • tangency-labs/solidcraft (Rust) ★ 13,377: SolidCraft: an open-source parametric 3D CAD application built in pure Rust. Desktop, web, and automation through MCP.
  • storytold/cadcraft (Rust) ★ 7,552: CADCraft: computer-aided design and drafting — an open-source, clean-room AutoCAD-style app in pure Rust

Telecom

  • absmach/magistrala (Go) ★ 2,658: IoT Platform Framework
  • Community-VyProjects/VyManager (TypeScript) ★ 491: Multi-tenant network management platform to configure, deploy, and monitor VyOS instances across multiple sites.
  • praetorian-inc/nerva (Go) ★ 376: Fast service fingerprinting CLI for 170+ protocols (TCP/UDP/SCTP) - built by Praetorian

5G

  • taubyte/tau (Go) ★ 5,183: Fullstack Workspace for Humans & Machines
  • open5gs/open5gs (C) ★ 2,802: Open5GS is a C-language Open Source implementation for 5G Core and EPC, i.e. the core network of LTE/NR network (Release-19)
  • free5gc/free5gc (Go) ★ 2,369: Open source 5G core network based on 3GPP R17
